fields.description: The frappe service account's own keypair on the box, generated by Setup. The private half never leaves it.
fields.label: Frappe Public Key

fields.description: From the Machine, as of this doc's last save. Code that dials the box reads the Machine live.
fields.label: Private IP

fields.description: The VPC the box is in, from the Machine as of this doc's last save. Code reads the Machine live.
fields.label: Network

fields.description: Whether this box's address survives a stop. Owned by the Machine — set it there.
fields.label: Static IP

fields.description: The agent that scrapes this box. Blank = not scraped.
fields.label: Monitoring Agent

fields.description: Where the control plane reaches this box's pathway.
fields.label: Admin URL

fields.description: The pathway release this box last installed successfully. Written by the deploy, not typed — it is what makes a fleet running mixed versions visible.
fields.label: Agent Version

fields.description: New requests get 503 with Retry-After while running ones finish. Written to config.json and applied with SIGUSR1, so it survives a restart. Start/End Maintenance under Gateway.
fields.label: Maintenance

fields.description: The Redis this box's agent was last deployed onto: its Network's Gateway Store when that was Active. Blank = its own loopback Redis. Written by the deploy, not typed.
fields.label: Gateway Store

fields.description: Route53 health check watching this box's /healthz. Its row in the region's multivalue set carries it, and the region's calculated check counts it as a child.
fields.label: Health Check ID
